Title: LR2 - ED-330 - Airworthiness-level design of safety-critical components (Class 3)
Text: For Class 3 (ARC B,C and SAIL V, VI) DAA, in addition to Class 2 (ARC B,C and SAIL IV) requirements, components essential to safe operations Shall be designed to an airworthiness design standards considered adequate by the competent authority and/or in accordance with a means of compliance acceptable to that authority to contribute to the overall safety objective.
